name: Depth Clipping for DDGI Probes
definition: A compression technique for DDGI light probe depth maps that reduces the dynamic range of stored depth values by clipping them to the maximum distance between adjacent probes, allowing probes with no nearby geometry to be identified as 'dead' and compressed efficiently.
summary: Depth Clipping for DDGI Probes compresses light probe depth maps by capping values at the maximum inter-probe distance, uniquely identifying empty probes as dead to enable efficient storage.
